stem: Which of these could follow sentence 5 and effectively state the central idea of this paper?

options.label: A
options.text: Kinney’s life story is a perfect example of a turn in life leading to great things.

options.label: B
options.text: Kinney wrote the books in the Diary of a Wimpy Kid series and some movies have been made.

options.label: C
options.text: Kinney had an interesting childhood and an even more interesting adulthood is what I think.

options.label: D
options.text: Kinney is a person that you should like a lot, and I am going to tell you why in this paper.
